reason: A Windows-focused DSH plugin that monitors agent task states and presents configurable Toast notifications, with optional local GUI-session activation when a notification is clicked.

summaries.zh: 一个面向 Windows 的 DSH 插件，用于在代理任务完成、出错或等待交互时发送可配置的桌面通知，并支持点击通知切回相关 GUI 会话。
summaries.en: A Windows-focused DSH plugin that sends configurable desktop notifications for agent completion, errors, and interaction waits, with optional click-through to the related GUI session.

capabilities: Monitors host agent status and task lifecycle events
Displays Windows Toast or notification-area notifications with configurable sounds
Invokes Windows PowerShell to create and display notifications
Creates or updates a local Windows shortcut, icon, and helper executable for notification identity
Opens or focuses a local GUI session through a custom protocol or HTTP deep link
Uses local browser and Windows UI automation to bring an existing GUI tab to the foreground
